market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. Oil above $108 and rising yields drive continued equity pressure. S&P 500 likely tests support as 4th-day slide continues. Fed hike bets and Bessent backfire create policy uncertainty. Canada trade war adds regional drag. Watch for oil pullback if Iran de-escalates.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI monetization (Meta Muse, HPE, MSFT) and Apple foldable cycle support tech leadership. Rising yields create attractive fixed-income entry. Trade wars and geopolitical risk cap upside. Energy transition and crypto-tradfi convergence offer structural tailwinds. 6-12 month path depends on oil normalization and Fed pivot.
